notes: Hand-authored, not derived. Rule: the file that owns the retry policy itself. src/server/jobs/webhook-delivery-job.ts declares MAX_ATTEMPTS (after which a delivery is marked failed for good), CLAIM_BATCH, and backoffMs() — the doubling wait capped at five minutes — and applies both while draining the queue. EXCLUDED: src/app/api/cron/webhook-delivery/route.ts (a thin trigger; its own header says the job computes the backoff); src/server/services/webhook-service.ts (enqueues rows and signs payloads, holds no attempt counting); src/server/repositories/webhook-repository.ts (claimPendingDeliveries / markDeliveryFailed persist the decision, they do not make it); src/server/jobs/queue.ts and scheduler.ts (generic job plumbing).
